job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: healthcare and pharmaceutical agency account management, client strategy, and adjacent client-services roles.

Core work: own client relationships; manage budgets, briefs, timelines, integrated campaign delivery, cross-functional teams, and regulated FDA and MLR review; translate client priorities into clear delivery plans; bring later UX, enterprise analytics, and regulated AI experience back into account leadership.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application.

classification.primarySource: The resume is the main evidence. It proves 7+ years managing Fortune 500 pharma and healthcare accounts, $2M-$50M+ budgets, FCB Health account leadership, brand planning, integrated campaigns, briefs, timelines, and MLR review.
classification.supportingSource: The portfolio shows what came after account management: regulated pharma workflows, client-led discovery, enterprise analytics, and presentation-ready recommendations. It supports the case that the UX and AI years made me better at client translation and delivery.

resume.summary: Healthcare account and client strategy leader looking to make a return to account management after 7+ years leading Fortune 500 pharma relationships and $2M-$50M+ budgets. Since then, I've worked inside UX, enterprise analytics, and regulated AI. I understand what clients need from an account lead, what delivery teams need from the brief, and where work is likely to stall.

hero.intro: I'm looking to make a return to account management after 7+ years leading Fortune 500 pharma and healthcare relationships and $2M-$50M+ budgets. Since then, I've worked inside UX, enterprise analytics, and regulated AI delivery. I now understand the handoff from both sides: what clients need from the account lead and what delivery teams need to turn a brief into finished work.
